The current time is 1714125600 and the file mtime is 1713952800. The difference is 172800 seconds (exactly 2 days). Since `MAX_AGE_SECONDS` is currently 25200 (7 hours), this 2-day old file would be incorrectly deleted. I will now fix the script.
